::: {.doc-subject}

Return a new recipe with ``steps`` appended (steps are pure).
:::

::: {.doc-usage-source}
Usage

[Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/recipe.py#L163-L189){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION}
```python
Recipe.add(*steps)
```
:::

## Examples {.doc-examples}

Each ``add()`` returns a new recipe, so steps chain into a pipeline
without mutating the original:



::: {#d8f177ff .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
(
    Recipe()
    .add(StepNormalize(s.numeric_predictors()))
    .add(StepDummy(s.nominal_predictors()))
)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2}
```
Recipe (untrained)
  Inputs: no roles assigned
  Steps:
    step_normalize(select(role='predictor', type=NumericType))              [untrained]
    step_dummy(select(role='predictor', type=(String, Categorical, Enum)))  [untrained]
```
:::
:::
